business_summary: FINDEX Inc. offers medical devices in Japan. It operates through Medical Business, Public Business, and Healthtech Business segments. The company provides Claio image filing system, C-Scan paper and digital document management system, DocuMaker document creation system, PDI+MoveBy referral information management system, C-Note medical record writing system, MapleNote perinatal system, REMORA electronic medical record, ID-Cam/Claio-Cam digital camera solution, UniversalSearcher medical big data search system, FAXde regional collaboration FAX referral management system, LIS endoscope system endoscopy department system, LIS ultrasound system ultrasound department system, ProRad RS radiology reporting system, gateway system, RemoTalkCloud, remote sharing app for medical information, C-Nys / C-Nys ME Nystagmus analysis support system, Cloud backup service security service, PiCls Medical Avenue for patient information app, PiCls On-examination online medical support system, PiCls AAdE-report electronic tracing report service, PiCls booking assistant first appointment online reservation service, PiCls connect medical institution collaboration service, WebeLi, and CocktailAI ,a generative AI for medical text generation; and DigiWorker, an RPA tool for healthcare. It also offers REMORA+Claio, an ophthalmology solution; G-QuICC DB Program, a glaucoma protocol; ENT package; DocuMaker Cloud, a medical certificate and other document creation service; REMORA Cloud, a cloud-based electronic medical record; C-Note + Claio, an ophthalmology solution; ClaioDashboard integrated viewing system; DocuMaker office, a document management system for administrative department; DocuMakerShelf, an electronic bookkeeping solution; and GAP-screener, line-of-sight analysis type perimeter for medical examination facilities. The company was formerly known as PSC Inc. and changed its name to FINDEX Inc. in November 2014. FINDEX Inc. was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.
